summary: Test-writing (red-phase) run for issue #5 'Replace hand-written API layer with a generated OpenAPI Swift client'. Deliverables of this run: (1) permanent Swift contract suite driving the to-be-generated client through the APIClient facade with all HTTP stubbed at the URLSession layer (no live server), covering manifest, recent sheets, capture creation, measurement upload, judgment upload, ranked results, bearer auth, and error mapping; (2) generated-module anchor test (import ColorMatchingAPI + documented Client(serverURL:transport:) init); (3) committed contract-delta analysis between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published OpenAPI spec (viamin/color_matching#110, inspected from the Phoenix repo source: api_spec.ex, api_schemas.ex, capture_controller.ex, test_sheet_controller.ex, test_sheet_json.ex, open_api_controller_test.ex), including 12 deltas (D1-D12) and 3 endpoint gaps (G1-G3). Swift toolchain is not installed in this container, so tests cannot be executed locally; they are committed red by design (no such module 'ColorMatchingAPI'/'OpenAPIURLSession') and become green in the follow-up implementation run, verified on macOS CI via `swift test`.
